title: Savings account that extends Account
statement: Define an Account class with a private attribute balance, a Balance method that returns it and a Deposit method that takes an amount and adds it to the balance. Define a SavingsAccount class that extends Account, also takes a rate, and has an ApplyInterest method that deposits the current balance times the rate divided by 100 (integer division). Read the balance and the rate, create the account, apply the interest and write the final balance.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
The statement asks the rate to be a private attribute.
